name: Honda Africa Twin CRF1100L
engine: 1,084 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected, manual or DCT
intro: Honda's big adventure twin. Several recalls cover the switchgear, DCT software and Adventure Sports tank.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2020-2022 and 2024-2025 bikes are in recall 25V583 for the left handlebar switch. 2020-2021 DCT bikes had ECU recall 22V662, and 2020 Adventure Sports models had fuel tank recall 20V797.
A-002.reason: These can cost you the horn, the headlight switch or engine power. Repairs are free.

E: Check the frame and subframe around crash bar and rack mounts for cracks after any drop.

recalls.what: Left handlebar switch may lose horn and headlight beam control.
ECU software can stall the engine or cut drive.
Fuel filter may clog from tank weld debris.
